policy_valid_values.name: policy_valid_values
policy_valid_values.value: "cancellation_policies"."notice_hours" >= 0 and "cancellation_policies"."late_fee_value" >= 0 and "cancellation_policies"."no_show_fee_value" >= 0 and "cancellation_policies"."late_fee_type" in ('percentage','fixed') and "cancellation_policies"."no_show_fee_type" in ('percentage','fixed') and ("cancellation_policies"."late_fee_type" <> 'percentage' or "cancellation_policies"."late_fee_value" <= 100) and ("cancellation_policies"."no_show_fee_type" <> 'percentage' or "cancellation_policies"."no_show_fee_value" <= 100)
